How fast can a charter be arranged?
It depends on aircraft availability and permissions, but urgent charters are often possible within days. During COVID-19 we arranged one in 72 hours.

The full range: ATR 72 turboprop freighters, Airbus A321 and Boeing 737 narrow-bodies, Boeing 757/767 and Airbus A330 freighters, Ilyushin Il-76, Boeing 777 and 747 freighters, and the Antonov An-124 for outsize cargo.
Is a charter only for very large shipments?
No. A part charter or an on-board courier can make sense for smaller, very urgent cargo.
